FTPS Client

gxsFTPClient transfers files with FTPS. Control and data connections are always encrypted.

Contents

Overview
Functions

Overview

Connect() uses explicit TLS (AUTH TLS on port 21) by default or implicit TLS (port 990). Login() sends PBSZ 0 and PROT P so every data connection is encrypted, then selects binary mode. Transfers are passive: EPSV first, then PASV, and the data connection always goes to the address of the control connection, never to an address in a PASV reply. Data connections reuse the control connection's TLS session, which most FTPS servers require.

Plain FTP is not supported. For transfers over SSH (SFTP) use an SSH library.

gxsFTPClient ftp;
long long bytes = 0;
if(ftp.Connect("ftp.example.com") == 0 && ftp.Login("user", "pw") == 0)
  ftp.Get("report.pdf", "report.pdf", bytes);
ftp.Quit();
